key_insight: Constraining each orbital’s effective potential to depend on the electron density excluding that orbital removes its self-interaction and satisfies the generalized Koopmans condition.
engineering_relevance: The approach could improve fundamental band-gap predictions for materials using LDA and GGA density functional approximations.
method: Constrain the effective potential for orbital i to depend on n − n_i.
Require total-energy linearity with respect to orbital-density variations.
Enforce orbital eigenenergies independent of their own fractional occupations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an approximately 1 eV reduction in fundamental band-gap mean absolute errors for LDA and GGA relative to standard KS-DFT.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify benchmark materials, computational overhead, or convergence behavior for the orbital-dependent potentials.
paper_title: Exact subtraction of electron self-interaction from the Kohn-Sham equations
